info.name: TaskFlow API
info.description: Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner (start the server first). Folders run in order: Auth -> Tasks -> Edge cases -> Sign out.

request.description: Uses the httpOnly refresh cookie that Postman stores automatically after login.

exec: pm.test("Task has defaults and owner", function () { const t = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(t.owner).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(t.status).to.eql("todo"); });

const e = pm.response.json().data.entry; pm.test("Entry is running with no end time", function () { pm.expect(e.isRunning).to.eql(true); pm.expect(e.endTime).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Start again on the same task

exec: pm.test("Server time and task are returned", function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.serverNow).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(d.active.task._id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("timerTaskA")); });
pm.test("Previous timer was stopped", function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.stopped.isRunning).to.eql(false); pm.expect(d.stopped.duration).to.be.a("number"); });
pm.test("Duration is a whole number of seconds", function () { pm.expect(Number.isInteger(pm.response.json().data.entry.duration)).to.eql(true); });

pm.test("Report has totals, daily series and per-task breakdown", function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d).to.include.keys("totalSeconds","sessions","daily","byTask"); pm.expect(d.daily.length).to.eql(7); });
const list = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set("entryId", list.length ? list[0]._id : ""); pm.test("Entries are listed", function () { pm.expect(list).to.be.an("array"); });
